cn-gb-15740.summary: GB 15740-2024 sets requirements for anti-theft devices of M and N category vehicles and for power immobilizers of M1 vehicles and N1 vehicles up to 2000 kg maximum mass, including information-security requirements. It applies from 2026-01-01 and replaces GB 15740-2006.
cn-gb-15740._why: Current summary truncated and lists alarms/shift locks/rollaway not in official scope.

cn-gb-1589._why: GB 1589-2016 implementation date 2016-07-26; no taxonomy system fits dimensions/masses so systems left empty.

cn-gb-18296-2019._why: R153 is rear-collision fuel system integrity (GB 20072 counterpart); R34 already in un_equivalent.

cn-gb-19578._why: R154 is WLTP emissions, not fuel consumption limits.

cn-gb-20071-2025.summary: GB 20071-2025 sets occupant protection requirements for lateral (side) collisions of M1 and N1 category vehicles, requiring compliance with side impact performance criteria that limit occupant injury from structural intrusion. It applies from 2026-07-01.
cn-gb-20071-2025._why: Official scope covers M1 and N1; current summary says M1 only and is truncated.

cn-gb-20072-2024.summary: GB 20072-2024 specifies safety requirements for passenger cars in the event of a rear-end collision, including fuel system integrity after rear impact. It applies to new type approvals from 2026-07-01.
cn-gb-20072-2024._why: Current summary truncated (...) and asserts unverified EV-specific content.

cn-gb-27887-2024._why: R145 is ISOFIX anchorage regulation (GB 14167 counterpart); R129 already in un_equivalent.

cn-gb-27999._why: R154 is WLTP emissions; R101 only measures CO2; no UN counterpart for fleet CAFC targets.

cn-gb-4094-2016._why: Symbols standard; does not regulate lighting.

cn-gb-44495-2024._why: R156 is software update (covered by GB 44496); R155 already in un_equivalent.

cn-gb-4785-2019._why: R148 is a light-signalling device regulation; GB 4785 is installation (R48 already listed).

cn-gb-t-34590.summary: GB/T 34590.10-2017 is a recommended (voluntary) guideline forming Part 10 of the road vehicles functional safety series, supporting application of ISO 26262 to safety-related E/E systems. It has been superseded by the GB/T 34590-2022 series.
cn-gb-t-34590._why: R100 is REESS safety, no UN counterpart; summary wrongly says it 'requires'; GB/T is voluntary guideline.
